lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਚਰਨਾ ਧੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi pavitr sareer charanaa dhooreeai ||
lines.translation: By body is sanctified, by the dust of Your feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀਐ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham guradev sadaa hajooreeai ||13||
lines.translation: O Supreme Lord God, Divine Guru, You are always with me, ever-present. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਸੁਨੰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa uchara(n)t naama(n) sravana(n) suna(n)t sabad a(n)mritah ||
lines.translation: With my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name; with my ears, I listen to the Ambrosial Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ਜਿਨਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sad balihaara(n) jinaa dhiaan paarabrahamanah ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਕੰਮ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਾਈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: habh kooRaave ka(n)m ikas saaee baahare ||
lines.translation: All concerns are false, except those of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak seee dha(n)n jinaa pirahaRee sach siu ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed are those, who are in love with their True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree tinaa j sunate har kathaa ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who listen to the sermon of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਨਿਵਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore te paradhaan nivaavahi prabh mathaa ||
lines.translation: Those who bow their heads before God are perfect and distinguished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਹਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas likhahi bea(n)t sohahi se hathaa ||
lines.translation: Those hands, which write the Praises of the infinite Lord are beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan puneet pavitr chaalahi prabh pathaa ||
lines.translation: Those feet which walk on God's Path are pure and holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g udhaar sagalaa dukh lathaa ||14||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, they are emancipated; all their sorrows depart. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੀ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaavee udot karana(n) har ramana(n) sa(n)jog pooranah ||
lines.translation: One's destiny is activated, when one chants the Lord's Name, through perfect good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸ ਭੇਟੰ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gopaal daras bheta(n) saphal naanak so mahooratah ||1||
lines.translation: Fruitful is that moment, O Nanak, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: keem na sakaa paai sukh mitee hoo baahare ||
lines.translation: Its value cannot be estimated; it brings peace beyond measure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਵੇਲੜੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦੜੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa velaRee paravaan jit mila(n)daRo maa piree ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that time alone is approved, when my Beloved meets with me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa velaa kahu kaun hai jit prabh kau paaee ||
lines.translation: Tell me, what is that time, when I shall find God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so moorat bhalaa sa(n)jog hai jit milai gusaaee ||
lines.translation: Blessed and auspicious is that moment, and that destiny, when I shall find the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har dhiaai kai man ichh pujaaee ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, my mind's desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)g hoi niv laagaa paaee ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Society of the Saints; I bow and touch their feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: man darasan kee piaas hai naanak bal jaaee ||15||
lines.translation: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet gobi(n)dah sarab dokh nivaaranah ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Dispeller of all distress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saran soor bhagavaanah japa(n)t naanak har har hare ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord God is Mighty, giving His Protective Sanctuary; Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਡਿਓ ਹਭੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਗੜੋ ਚਰਣਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhadio habh aap lagaRo charanaa paas ||
lines.translation: Renouncing all self-conceit, I hold tight to the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਠੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖੰਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nathaRo dukh taap naanak prabh pekha(n)diaa ||2||
lines.translation: My sorrows and troubles have departed, O Nanak, beholding God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਦੁਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mel laihu daiaal dhahi pae duaariaa ||
lines.translation: Unite with me, O Merciful Lord; I have fallen at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਹੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakh levahu deen daiaal bhramat bahu haariaa ||
lines.translation: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad har patit udhaariaa ||
lines.translation: It is Your very nature to love Your devotees, and save sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਨਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin naahee koi binau mohi saariaa ||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other at all; I offer this prayer to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi lehu daiaal saagar sa(n)saariaa ||16||
lines.translation: Take me by the hand, O Merciful Lord, and carry me across the world-ocean. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਰਣ ਦਇਆਲੰ ਆਸਰੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t udharan daiaala(n) aasara(n) gopaal keeratanah ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Savior of the Saints; their only support is to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: niramala(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen ot naanak paramesurah ||1||
lines.translation: One becomes immaculate and pure, by associating with the Saints, O Nanak, and taking the Protection of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸਰਦ ਰੁਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਘਾਂਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan cha(n)d na sarad rut mool na mitaee ghaa(n)m ||
lines.translation: The burning of the heart is not dispelled at all, by sandalwood paste, the moon, or the cold season.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਪੰਦੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: seetal theevai naanakaa japa(n)daRo har naam ||2||
lines.translation: It only becomes cool, O Nanak, by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee ot udhare sagal jan ||
lines.translation: Through the Protection and Support of the Lord's lotus feet, all beings are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਮਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun parataap govi(n)d nirabhau bhae man ||
lines.translation: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe, the mind becomes fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai mool sa(n)chiaa naam dhan ||
lines.translation: Nothing at all is lacking, when one gathers the wealth of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੈ ਪੁਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa siu sa(n)g paaeeai vadai pun ||
lines.translation: The Society of the Saints is obtained, by very good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਨ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har dhiaai har jas nit sun ||17||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord, and listen continually to the Lord's Praises. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਣੰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karana(n) dukh harana(n) ucharana(n) naam keeratanah ||
lines.translation: The Lord grants His Grace, and dispels the pains of those who sing the Kirtan of the Praises of His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal purakh bhagavaanah naanak lipat na maaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: When the Lord God shows His Kindness, O Nanak, one is no longer engrossed in Maya. ||1||
